name: Create Durable User from Passkey Proof
summary: Creates one durable user only after a PendingIdentity contains validated passkey proof and identity-resolution policy permits creation.

requiredInputs.description: Passkey PendingIdentity approved for new-user creation.

guards.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and credential-proof == passkey-proved and no existing canonical identity matches

sourceReferences.note: CompletePasswordlessRegistrationAsync currently creates AppUser during attestation completion; this action separates that mutation
